amendment_2_epsilon_role.question: does epsilon=22.948043518066406 us enter the clear-crossover verdict?
amendment_2_epsilon_role.ruling: NO. Following the frozen crosstab_v1 precedent (crosstab_execution_protocol.json: row_tracks_own_base = 'both other-base-minus-own-base paired 95% CIs exclude zero positively'), the CD-X0 primary criteria row_tracks_own_base and clear_crossover_advantage use CI-excludes-zero ONLY; epsilon is never a threshold for the verdict
epsilon_uses_enumerated: per-contrast descriptive label practically_equivalent_within_margin = CI wholly inside [-epsilon, +epsilon] (equivalence is claimed only then; crossing zero alone does not, per frozen rule)
descriptive oracle-gap context (gaps below epsilon per forward are flagged as within-margin)
amendment_2_epsilon_role.rationale: epsilon was calibrated at ~4050-row captures; CD-X0 rows range ~4000-16384 (amendment 5), so epsilon is not re-tuned (prohibited) and is kept out of verdicts entirely

amendment_3_multiple_comparisons.family: 24 primary paired contrasts = 2 layers x 4 rows x 3 own-vs-other-base contrasts
amendment_3_multiple_comparisons.ruling: all primary labels are EXPLORATORY screening: verdict strings must carry the word 'exploratory'; no family-wise error rate control is claimed for detected/not_detected/indeterminate
amendment_3_multiple_comparisons.secondary_sensitivity: Holm-Bonferroni adjusted p-values are computed and reported WITHIN each layer (family = that layer's 12 contrasts) for every contrast, as descriptive sensitivity only; they never alter the pre-registered verdict
amendment_3_multiple_comparisons.confirmatory_use: any confirmatory claim from these or new data requires a NEW pre-registered protocol with a pre-specified multiplicity rule; this pilot cannot be relabeled confirmatory post hoc

amendment_4_own_base_not_necessary_condi.ruling: row_tracks_own_base / clear_crossover is ONE pre-registered binary screening summary. It is NOT a necessary condition for cross-domain tracking value: a layer can fail the screen while individual cells still show meaningful layout-domain interaction (e.g., a domain base beating identity everywhere, or partial row tracking)
mandatory_reporting: the complete per-layer 4x5 cell matrix: cell estimates, per-start values, within-block paired CIs for all 20 pairs, not only the 12 own-vs-other contrasts
per-row best column and its delta versus identity and versus own base
descriptive oracle gaps (row-equal K and K-tilde weighted, with the assumption note)
pairwise column displacement counts and frozen C_batch migration-cost context
amendment_4_own_base_not_necessary_condi.verdict_wording: 'not_detected' means only that the pre-registered screen did not fire on these two layers and candidates at replay caliber; it is NOT evidence of absence of exploitable cross-domain structure, and 'detected' is NOT a whole-service benefit claim

amendment_5_batch_metadata_and_capture_m.decision: ADOPT the proven prediction_v1 frozen-request-batch capture mechanism INSTEAD OF the original protocol's mid-service client-index triggers
amendment_5_batch_metadata_and_capture_m.reason: the frozen-batch mechanism records complete batch composition metadata BY CONSTRUCTION (per-request source line indices, domains, tokenized lengths, sums; indexer verifies captured hidden rows equal the request token multiset), so domain purity is VERIFIABLE, not merely bounded; the mid-service trigger design could not record batch composition without modifying the deployed capture patch and bench client, and its purity caveat was pre-registered as unverifiable

batch_selection_rule_pre_registered.rule: per (split, domain): scan the domain segment FORWARD in source-line order from the segment midpoint (inclusive); retain requests whose Qwen3-tokenized prompt length (add_special_tokens=True) lies in [400, 2048]; if fewer than 8 by segment end, continue BACKWARD from midpoint-1 to segment start; take the first 8 in scan order
batch_selection_rule_pre_registered.uniformity: one identical content-only rule for all 4 domains and both splits; uses NO routing, layout or performance information
batch_selection_rule_pre_registered.why_not_500_512: the prediction_v1 band [500,512] was scanned before freezing: book domain has ZERO requests below 950 tokens and code domain is uniformly 2048 tokens in both splits (0 in-band); band [400,2048] is feasible in all 8 segments (sharegpt >=443, prover >=1977, book >=1006, code all)
batch_selection_rule_pre_registered.min_400_rationale: every rank's captured forward must reach min_hidden_rows=400; with 8 concurrent requests and dp-attention assignment, one request per rank, per-request tokens >=400 guarantees the gate on all 8 ranks (empirically the prediction_v1 pattern, 18/18 units)
batch_selection_rule_pre_registered.batch_size_8_rationale: 8 = one request per dp rank; fewer requests leave ranks without a >=400-row forward and the unit cannot complete (all 8 rank files required)

row_count_heterogeneity_documented.impact_on_statistics: all primary contrasts are WITHIN-row paired (same capture, different layouts), so row-count differences across rows do not bias them; the inherited epsilon labels are relatively stricter for larger rows (descriptive only, amendment 2)
row_count_heterogeneity_documented.oracle_gap_note_update: the K-tilde assumption note gains one clause: rows are NOT equal-token across domains in CD-X0 (book ~2x, code ~4x the sharegpt/prover rows); row-equal K and K-tilde weightings bracket the descriptive range and neither is a service-caliber quantity
row_count_heterogeneity_documented.replay_feasibility_evidence: DeepEP normal-mode buffer sizing is independent of SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK (deepep.py DeepEPBuffer.get_deepep_buffer: the parameter is used only for low-latency RDMA sizing; assert <=1024 concerns internode_ll); the five-arm service ran 2048-token code prefills (48.6% of evaluation tokens) for hours under the same env=512 normal-mode configuration; a pre-freeze smoke replay of one code-sized capture validates the harness end-to-end before any formal start

execution_discipline_clarification.failed_start_handling: run_cdx0_execution.sh writes the failure record, retires the start (no retry, per frozen protocol) and CONTINUES with the remaining starts; the row-validity rule (<3 valid starts -> indeterminate row) from the protocol applies; this continuation is the implementation of the frozen validity rule, not a relaxation
